title: Coping with Anxiety
content: Practice the 4-7-8 breathing technique: inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 7 seconds, exhale for 8 seconds to calm your nervous system.

title: Understanding Depression
content: Depression involves persistent sadness, fatigue, or loss of interest. Professional help, like therapy or medication, can be effective.

title: National Suicide Prevention Lifeline
content: Call 988 for free, confidential support 24/7 if you or someone you know is in crisis.

title: Mindfulness Journaling
content: Write down three things you’re grateful for daily to focus on positive aspects of life.

title: Crisis Text Line
content: Text HOME to 741741 to connect with a trained crisis counselor for free, 24/7 support.

title: Managing Stress
content: Engage in physical activity, such as a 30-minute walk, to reduce stress hormones and improve mood.

title: What is Cognitive Behavioral Therapy?
content: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) helps identify and change negative thought patterns to improve mental health.

title: Grounding Techniques for Anxiety
content: Use the 5-4-3-2-1 technique: name 5 things you see, 4 you can touch, 3 you hear, 2 you smell, and 1 you taste.

title: SAMHSA National Helpline
content: Call 1-800-662-HELP (4357) for free, confidential referrals to mental health and substance use treatment.

title: Benefits of Meditation
content: Meditation can reduce stress and improve focus. Start with 5 minutes daily using guided apps or quiet reflection.

title: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
content: Tense and release each muscle group in your body, starting from your toes, to reduce physical tension.

title: Understanding Bipolar Disorder
content: Bipolar disorder involves mood swings from mania to depression. Treatment includes therapy and medication.

title: Trevor Project Lifeline
content: Call 1-866-488-7386 for 24/7 crisis support for LGBTQ youth.

title: Guided Visualization
content: Imagine a peaceful place, like a beach, and focus on sensory details to relax your mind.

title: Signs of Burnout
content: Burnout includes exhaustion, cynicism, and reduced performance. Address it with rest and professional support.
